changing ownership of persistence, provider DOM, or workflow state

changeLog.change: Split bridge destination matching into extension-identity and session helpers; v2 point-to-point routing behavior and fail-closed tests remain unchanged.
Split connection-v2 envelope validation into header, scope, timing and integrity helpers; preserve deterministic fail-closed codes while reducing the main validator's complexity.
Split connection-v2 envelope validation into header, scope, timing and integrity helpers without changing fail-closed error codes; protocol/bridge regression coverage remains green.

Protocol v2 RUN_JOB and CANCEL_JOB now require an exact extension installation, connector instance, browser tab and frame destination; invalid or missing tab/frame identities fail closed before desktop routing.

Added process-level crash-window regression coverage: an interrupted Flow job with durable submit intent becomes reconciliation_required, requests strict recovery, keeps provider acceptance unset and never becomes a watchdog failure.
Protocol v2 now requires leaseId and fencingToken on ACK, provider acceptance and result envelopes, aligning inbound stale-lease rejection with the declared one-to-one delivery contract.
Bridge manager now binds v2 job retries to the active endpoint leaseId and fencingToken; stale split-brain tokens fail closed, with contract coverage for endpoint/token mismatch.
Added bridge-runtime idle-budget integration coverage for zero, canonical-one and duplicate-two provider-tab visibility; verifies probe counts and no leftover discovery timer after bounded search.

Bound extension discovery probes for duplicate/incomplete provider tabs as well as empty visibility; candidate diagnostics remain available but no longer wake the worker indefinitely after the startup budget.

Split extension bridge runtime discovery/status, socket lifecycle and native request helpers while preserving the public runtime contract; architecture rules now report one fewer complexity and function-length hotspot.

Added isolated packaged MV3 pairing smoke with a fake loopback bridge: first approval, service-worker target restart, stored-secret resume and no RUN_JOB side effects; extension bridge port is build-time configurable for the fixture.

Added bounded pairing resume after extension service-worker reconnect: stored secret proves a fresh challenge with installation/session identity; resume never re-delivers secret or restores a job submit action.

Added bounded desktop pairing session state (challenge, explicit code approval, secret delivery, identity-bound confirmation and three-attempt lockout); v2 message transport remains gated until confirmation.
Account/Connection onboarding now renders four independently observable Flow boundary checks with localized status labels and bounded refresh actions; UI smoke covers all four steps.
Protocol v2 now enforces a five-minute maximum envelope lifetime in addition to bounded clock-skew checks; overlong expiry windows fail closed before routing or dispatch.
Added Electron safeStorage-backed pairing secret persistence with atomic mode-0600 writes and fail-closed corrupt/unavailable states; bridge receives the secret only when a secure value is available.

Added a versioned binary-handle contract with opaque id, issuer/consumer/ACK owner, bounded size/TTL, single-use state, explicit no-resume/backpressure policy and runtime revoke/expiry handling; transport integration remains separate.

Extension asset downloader now enforces provider-scoped HTTPS host allowlists, validates the final fetch URL and supports blob URLs only when their embedded HTTPS origin is allowlisted; disallowed redirects fail before download.

Local provider video results are now ffprobe-verified before asset creation when the desktop toolchain is available; missing video stream, missing duration and metadata mismatch over 0.25s fail closed without import.
Provider media trust validation now rejects non-finite, non-positive or over-one-hour declared durations before filesystem reads/import; actual ffprobe duration remains a separate pending gate.
Added bounded bridge-runtime reconnect smoke with a fake WebSocket: worker session restart emits one HELLO per socket, schedules capped reconnect and never implicitly emits RUN_JOB.
Added offline extension package verifier for MV3 manifest parity, required bundles, content-script paths and Node syntax checks; it fails before publish when a built artifact is incomplete.

Added Playwright UI geometry matrix smoke across Compact 1200x920, Compact floor 1180x760, Max 1440x900 and Max-wide 1920x1080 for all eight core views; document and shell columns must remain within viewport.

Protocol v2 now has deterministic malformed-corpus fuzz coverage, required-field matrix coverage and exact expiry/clock-skew boundary tests; validator remains total and fail-closed for untrusted input.

Bridge server factory now forwards desktop identity, optional pairing verifier, lease release and retention guards into every socket message boundary; prevents production-only lease wiring loss and enforces configured destination/auth checks.

Persisted submit intent and explicit submission states before bridge delivery; restart normalization now marks an unfinished intent as reconciliation-required instead of inferring provider acceptance.
Added shared capability negotiation metadata and desktop pre-dispatch filtering for protocol/provider/executor/task/message-size compatibility while preserving legacy v1 endpoints.

Added desktop job-target lease affinity so retry/cancel messages remain point-to-point on the original extension endpoint; terminal results and socket drops release the lease without disturbing fair rotation for other jobs.
Persisted a desktop instance identity atomically and wired it into the bridge server's v2 destination validation; legacy v1 traffic remains compatible.
Persisted an opaque extension installation identity separately from each service-worker session so desktop diagnostics can distinguish restarts without treating a new worker as a new installation.

Added a bounded extension discovery state contract: startup search probes stop at a fixed budget, duplicate/incomplete Flow tabs remain candidates, and only a canonical workspace enters low-energy diagnostics shared with desktop and popup.

Activated Flow UI-direct readiness on one plain workspace, separated semantic preflight evidence from the one-keyframe provider transport, and hardened composer discovery against the live add_2 source control.

Made the Google Flow executor explicit per job: new video jobs select the normal workspace UI-direct v2 path, historical jobs retain custom-tool v1 semantics, and desktop WebSocket transport remains unchanged.

Added a versioned character identity contract rendered as compact YAML, persisted provider provenance for reference transport, and unified production-task status semantics across navigation, toast, and durable activity history.

Applied independent audit critical fixes: desktop IPC mutations now use the state-store mutation boundary; workflow orchestration consumes an injectable bridge contract; renderer no longer imports workflow through a relative source path.
Split extension durable job/result payload types from the compatibility types facade; background runtime modules now consume the narrow job-types contract.
Split high fan-in domain text helpers into labels, layout, and identifiers boundaries; workflow imports now target the narrow contract they consume while text-support remains a compatibility facade.

Moved Flow pointer gestures and media-picker overlay controls into a dependency-injected DOM-controls boundary; content.ts now composes provider interaction primitives rather than defining them inline.
Added behavior contract coverage for Flow workspace/diagnostics and ChatGPT wait-tier boundaries; tests exercise runtime contracts rather than source text patterns.
